propositions: Eight CI lanes (external-integration, test.yml external, structured-output-baseline, eval-discipline, optionality, jira-dc-harness, langfuse-trace, external-llm) lacked per-test hang guards despite having shared suite precedent with --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread
Unguarded lanes can experience deadlocked tests that hide behind output dots with no traceback or culprit identification, running under GitHub's 360-minute default job timeout
Per-test budgets must be calibrated individually per lane based on observed mean runtime (at least 10x floored at 300s) rather than using a blanket timeout across all lanes

Detection rule in parity test must match pytest invocations across four command forms (bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, path-prefixed) while rejecting non-invoking text like pip install lines and shell comments
All eight lanes now carry lane-specific --timeout and --timeout-method=thread flags with YAML comments recording evidence and budget rationale for auditability
